node: Semiconductor equipment subsystems: vacuum, RF power, gas flow, measurement, motion control, and process-control components embedded inside larger wafer-fab tools
summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the US-listed universe around semiconductor equipment subsystems. The reference lane is represented by Applied Materials as a visible WFE OEM context anchor, while the main underfollowed lane prioritizes MKS Instruments, Ichor Holdings, and Ultra Clean Holdings. These companies are plausibly exposed to fab capex through subsystems embedded in larger wafer-fab tools rather than through direct AI-chip design wins. The strongest direct-node evidence in this pass is for Ichor and Ultra Clean in gas/fluid/chemical delivery subsystems and for MKS in vacuum/process-control subsystems. Key next checks are customer concentration, OEM qualification durability, semi revenue mix, margins through WFE cycles, and whether AI-driven advanced logic/memory/packaging intensity is translating into subsystem orders.
